calculation.expression: factor_value = VIX_ROC_20d for safe-haven assets (XAU, US10Y, CN10Y), -VIX_ROC_20d for risk assets. Where VIX_ROC_20d = (VIX[t] / VIX[t-20] - 1.0).
calculation.description: 20-day rate of change of VIX index, applied as a risk-on/off rotation signal. When VIX is rising (positive ROC), safe-haven assets (XAU, US10Y, CN10Y) receive positive factor loading while risk assets receive negative loading. When VIX is falling (negative ROC), risk assets receive positive loading and safe havens negative. This predicts cross-asset rotation at 10d horizon.

validation.regime_notes: Validated 2024-03-08..2027-05-05. VIX range 12-44, current VIX=36.08 elevated. Cross-asset universe of 15 instruments. Factor applies risk-on/off rotation logic based on VIX trend direction of change.
